text: 立讯精密公告，截至2026年10月15日，公司通过股份回购专用证券账户以集中竞价方式回购A股股份1766.54万股，占公司总股本的比例为0.23%，占公司A股总股本的比例为0.24%，最高成交价65元/股，最低成交价50.14元/股，成交总金额10亿元（不含交易费用）。回购价格未超过86.66元/股，资金来源为公司自筹资金（含股票回购专项贷款资金等）。回购股份用于后期实施股权激励计划或员工持股计划。因回购期间实施权益分派，回购价格上限由86.96元/股先后调整为86.8元/股、86.66元/股。
text_en: Luxshare Precision announced that as of October 15, 2026, the company repurchased 17.6654 million A-shares through its dedicated securities account for share repurchases via centralized bidding, representing 0.23% of the company's total share capital and 0.24% of the company's total A-share capital, at a maximum transaction price of RMB 65 per share and a minimum transaction price of RMB 50.14 per share, with a total transaction amount of RMB 1 billion (excluding transaction fees). The repurchase price did not exceed RMB 86.66 per share, and the source of funds was the company's self-raised funds (including funds from special loans for share repurchases, etc.). The repurchased shares are to be used for implementing an equity incentive plan or employee stock ownership plan at a later stage. Due to the implementation of equity distribution during the repurchase period, the upper limit of the repurchase price was adjusted from RMB 86.96 per share to RMB 86.8 per share and then to RMB 86.66 per share.
